title: AI Tools - native preview
codex_rpm_scope: Initial ChatGPT Desktop with Codex RPM installation, Linux amd64/arm64, DNF5 only. Requires CORE confirmation, --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. Exact official latest RPM, bounded download and local SHA256 continuity; no independent publisher-signature claim. Existing RPM records are preserved. DNF5 stores a plan that must contain exactly one Install of chatgpt; dependencies must already be satisfied. Repositories are disabled for this operation; no dependency changes, upgrades, removals, DNF4 fallback or upstream shell installer. Administrator signature settings/versionlocks/excludes are not disabled. DNF5 replay plus before/after checks is the approved coordination boundary, not exclusion against concurrent RPM or other package frontends. RPM package scripts and trusted system plugins still run with privilege and may configure repositories/services. No automatic rollback. Failure/cancellation retains evidence and may leave privileged descendants running. Menu/status show ATM journal evidence only, never query RPM or prove current installation/health. Update/removal and real Fedora acceptance remain Pending.

preview: Preview only: portable PicoClaw, Hermes Desktop AppImage, Codex CLI and Ollama bundles; explicit portable Ollama user-service register/start/stop/remove/status; Hermes Desktop system DEB; ChatGPT Desktop with Codex latest-only system DEB install/update and nonpurge removal; initial-only DNF5 RPM install with dependencies already satisfied; explicit Hermes Agent official PM preparation. Ollama root/system installation and autostart, Codex Desktop RPM update/removal/dependency workflows and Arch, remaining Hermes lifecycle and real provider/service/platform acceptance remain Pending; the production AI plugin is unchanged.
hermes_scope: Hermes Agent source/PM preview, Linux glibc amd64/arm64. Only the reviewed v0.22.5 source commit is enabled; a newer latest release is refused until reviewed. Exact selection reuses an already completed owned preparation without downloads or PM execution. Explicit PATH enrollment copies the native bridge; detach keeps that receipt-owned copy dormant. Reenrollment reuses the verified copy. Explicit launcher refresh replaces only an already owned copy with the current native AI backend, preserving enrollment and profiles. Deactivation with --keep-preparation removes only owned PATH enrollment, the native bridge and ATM selection. The entire preparation, source, Python environments and private HOME/data stay at their existing paths; external installations and profiles are not adopted. No physical preparation/data deletion, multi-version support, data migration, frontend builds or services in this slice.

hermes_consent: Install/update requires CORE confirmation, --trust-download and --accept-dependency-execution. Exact completed selection requires CORE confirmation only, with no downloads or execution. Preparation trusts official GitHub source metadata, upstream uv and the official PM plus dependency build code. PM downloads dependencies and can execute code with your user's privileges; a private HOME is not a sandbox. Browser/computer-use optional packages are declined. No credentials are inherited. Installation may be large/slow; interrupted attempts are retained for manual inspection, not silently deleted or retried.

ollama_scope: Portable Ollama base bundle, with optional amd64 ROCm companion. Updates preserve the selected variant; --rocm opts into the companion for install/update. Same-version variant changes are refused. Bundle operations do not execute providers or change GPU drivers, system packages, models or services. PATH integration and the ATM user service are separate explicit actions. Stop and remove the ATM service registration before any bundle install/update/selection/removal; stopping alone does not release the version pin. Uninstall detaches exact owned PATH integration before removing versions, preserving service data. Manually stop other processes using the bundle; they are not probed. Runtime/GPU acceptance remains Pending; external installations and ollama.service are never adopted.
ollama_service_scope: Optional ATM portable USER service: atm-ollama.service, not the upstream root/system installation. Actions register/start/stop/remove require --accept-service-execution and CORE confirmation; explicit status is readonly. This menu does not query the manager. Default ~/.config/systemd/user must match the actual manager UnitPath. Register does not start or enable; autostart/linger are deferred. Explicit start runs the selected verified version-pinned bundle using env -i, private HOME/models and 127.0.0.1:11434. No inherited provider credentials, personal config, shell, sudo, drivers or package actions. This is not a sandbox; Type=exec confirms the env wrapper, not provider or inference health. Model/data files survive stop, removal, re-registration and bundle uninstall. Foreign units, aliases, drop-ins and uncertain states are refused; interruption retains journals/locks for manual inspection. https://docs.ollama.com/linux https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.service.html https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.exec.html

codex_desktop_scope: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: latest-only system DEB install/update, Linux APT amd64/arm64; this is not a claim of support for every Linux derivative. Install refuses any existing chatgpt record. Explicit update affects the observed system package regardless of its origin, without claiming ownership or adopting personal data; it requires exact installed state, valid Debian version and matching architecture. Held, incomplete, absent or unknown packages are refused. Updates use --only-upgrade, never implicitly install chatgpt or downgrade; Debian-equal versions are a no-op, not a reinstall. APT may install or upgrade dependencies and execute package scripts/triggers as root, affecting services and desktop integration. Custom APT preferences/paths are refused. ATM downloads the fixed official latest DEB; it does not refresh APT indexes or configure repositories. No forced removal, repair, adoption, app launch, sign-in or profile edits by ATM. Explicit nonpurge uninstall is separately consented below. Initial-only DNF5 installation has a separate RPM provider; RPM update/removal and Arch remain Pending.
codex_desktop_consent: Install/update requires CORE confirmation, --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. Trust is the exact official HTTPS download origin only. No upstream checksum or independent signature was discovered; locally computed SHA-256 checks byte continuity into root staging, not independent authenticity. Positive exact Content-Length and a 512 MiB bound are required; redirects are refused. Uses trusted commands via sudo -n with cached authorization: authenticate separately in a terminal when required; ATM never reads passwords. Failure/interruption may leave package-manager work running, partial installs and retained staging/locks. No automatic recovery, cleanup from journal paths or rollback is promised.
codex_desktop_remove: Uninstall observed system ChatGPT Desktop package (any origin; nonpurge; accept root scripts)
codex_desktop_remove_scope: Explicit uninstall requires CORE confirmation and --accept-system-packages only, with no download trust, version or other flags. It removes the observed chatgpt package of any origin without claiming ownership/adoption. Only exact install ok installed, valid-version, matching amd64/arm64 architecture is eligible; held, absent, incomplete and unknown states are refused. A root-staged, hash-checked native helper pins the original record at early/final locked checks and requires protocol 3 with exactly one matching REMOVE action and fixed nonpurge policy. No downloads, index updates, autoremove, repair, other package actions or pending configure/remove/purge commands are requested. APT/dpkg maintainer scripts, triggers and existing hooks still execute as root and may affect services, integration and data; this is not a sandbox or a guarantee against upstream script side effects. ATM does not explicitly delete user data, profiles or configuration; only its own invocation staging is cleaned after verified success. Uses sudo -n and a fixed env -i environment; authenticate separately if required. Failure/cancellation can leave descendants running, package state uncertain and staging/locks retained. No automatic cleanup from journal paths or rollback.
codex_desktop_remove_journal: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: recorded removal phase=%s; last phase=%s; original version=%s; architecture=%s. No package download, source URL or DEB digest applies. Journal paths never authorize recovery or cleanup; runtime/ownership unverified.

codex_desktop_guard: Installation/update uses a root-staged, locally hash-checked copy of the native ATM backend. APT invokes fixed native guards through its internal /bin/sh hook mechanism, not an upstream installer or Bash fallback. The early guard runs before preconfiguration; the final guard validates the exact package plan. Both verify the original package baseline unchanged, require the real frontend write lock owned by a verified root APT ancestor and fresh acknowledgements binding operation, baseline and artifact. Existing Pre-Invoke hooks, redirected databases/roots, incompatible dpkg options, disabled locking, and missing/nonempty dpkg updates directories are refused. Stock Pre-Install-Pkgs hooks are retained. A trusted env -i wrapper sets HOME=/ and the fixed command environment after sudo; no inherited HOME or APT_CONFIG is trusted.

system_scope: System DEB install only, Linux amd64. APT may install or upgrade Hermes Desktop and dependencies and execute package scripts/triggers as root, which may affect services and desktop integration. Administrator configuration is not rewritten. Nonempty preferences or custom preference paths are refused because local DEB installs can bypass pins. No removal, forced downgrade or ownership adoption.
system_consent: Requires CORE confirmation plus --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. The download trusts fathah/hermes-desktop GitHub HTTPS release metadata and its SHA-256, not an independent signature. Uses trusted literal commands via sudo -n; authenticate separately in a terminal if policy requires it. ATM never reads passwords. This offline menu does not resolve releases, query packages or verify sudo access.

path_scope: Explicit PATH integration prepends the owned command directory in .profile, .bashrc and existing .zshrc under the default user HOME. trust: Download consent trusts the named upstream executable and its GitHub release SHA-256 metadata. This is not an independent signature. Portable downloads do not run the executable, install dependencies, edit profiles or configure services. PATH integration is a separate explicitly confirmed action.
appimage: AppImage runtime dependencies (including compatible FUSE when required) must be installed separately. ATM does not execute or extract the AppImage runtime.
preserved: Manual and legacy installations, models, credentials and settings are not adopted or removed. Only exact owned PATH blocks are changed by explicit integration or detached during uninstall; unrelated profile content is preserved. Portable versions come from private preview receipts; ChatGPT Desktop system versions are observed dpkg package records, not ownership/runtime verification.
